description: This file contains integration tests for the Catalog Item creation endpoint in the Public API of the eShopOnWeb project. It tests authorization scenarios and successful item creation, using HTTP client requests and verifying responses.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: A test class providing integration tests for the 'Create Catalog Item' API endpoint, validating authorization and successful creation.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Tests that a normal user token is unauthorized to create a new catalog item, expecting a Forbidden status.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that an admin user token successfully creates a new catalog item and verifies the returned data.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Constructs and returns JSON content representing a valid new catalog item request.
